name: Ruzora Hiring Agent
description: Ruzora connects US companies with vetted senior software engineers in Latin America. Agents can browse blind profiles of vetted engineers, verify a Ruzora Vetted badge, request a vetted shortlist (within 72 hours), check fit for a hiring quote, send a candidate Ruzora's coding challenge and track a coding challenge's status. Profiles stay blind until a service agreement is signed. Read skills are open; skills that send data need a verified work email (verify_work_email, then confirm_work_email, then "Authorization: Bearer <buyer_token>"). Tasks complete synchronously; a refused task says the next step in its status message.

skills.name: Search Ruzora's Vetted Engineers
skills.description: See blind profiles of senior engineers in Latin America who already passed Ruzora's coding and interview vetting and are available now, filtered by stack, level and US-hours overlap. Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.

skills.name: Verify a Ruzora Vetted Badge
skills.description: Check that a candidate's "Ruzora Vetted" badge is real and current, which stacks it covers, and when the vetting happened. Pass the badge ID or badge URL. Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.
examples: {"skill":"verify_ruzora_badge","input":{"badge":"<the badge link exactly as the candidate shared it>"}}

skills.name: Check a Ruzora Vetting Request
skills.description: Check progress on a coding challenge you sent through Ruzora: not started, in progress, finished, or expired, and scores once the report is delivered. Pass the status page URL. Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.

skills.name: Verify a Work Email
skills.description: Step 1 before a Ruzora action that needs a verified buyer: emails the user a 6-digit code and a confirm link. The user reads the code back; confirm_work_email takes it. Sends the email address to Ruzora. Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.

skills.name: Confirm a Work Email
skills.description: Step 2: the 6-digit code the user read from the email, with the verification_id from verify_work_email (or the verification_id alone once they clicked the link), becomes a buyer_token for verified Ruzora actions, valid 7 days, and opens their Sol account. Sends the email and code to Ruzora. Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.

skills.name: Request a Vetted Engineer Shortlist
skills.description: Ask Ruzora for a shortlist of vetted senior engineers in Latin America for a role (ideally from a role scorecard). A vetted shortlist within 72 hours; profiles are blind until an agreement is signed. Needs a work email. Sends the name, email and company given to Ruzora. Needs a verified work email: send "Authorization: Bearer <buyer_token>" (from verify_work_email then confirm_work_email). Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.

skills.name: Check Fit for a Hiring Quote
skills.description: Answer Ruzora's 5 quick questions (roles, runway, budget per engineer, timing) to see whether a quote makes sense and the next step to it: usually a 15-minute call with the founder. Explains the flat monthly pricing; no price list. Sends the name, email and company given to Ruzora. Needs a verified work email: send "Authorization: Bearer <buyer_token>" (from verify_work_email then confirm_work_email). Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.

skills.name: Send a Candidate the Ruzora Coding Challenge
skills.description: Runs Ruzora's coding challenge + technical questions (~25 min, free) on a candidate the user found; returns a candidate link and a status link. Needs the user's confirmation that the candidate knows. Sends both names, the email, company and profile links to Ruzora. Needs a verified work email: send "Authorization: Bearer <buyer_token>" (from verify_work_email then confirm_work_email). Call it with SendMessage: one data part {"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}} (mediaType application/json); the input fields are in the card extension https://www.ruzora.com/a2a/extensions/skill-input-schema/v1.

author: Ruzora LLC

pricing.details: Agent calls are free. Discovery skills need no auth; buyer actions need a Ruzora buyer token from verify_work_email then confirm_work_email. Endpoint speaks A2A 1.0 only (JSON-RPC, header A2A-Version: 1.0; SendMessage/GetTask/ListTasks/CancelTask).
